q: Who owns the code and the intellectual property?
a: You do, on final payment, in full. That includes the source, the infrastructure definitions, and the documentation. We keep no licence over your systems and we do not reuse client code in other engagements.

q: What timezone overlap do we actually get?
a: We operate in UTC+5. That is a full working morning overlapping Europe and an afternoon overlapping the US East Coast. We commit to a fixed daily overlap window in writing before a project starts rather than leaving it to chance.

Once the project is delivered, we provide the necessary documentation, access, and handover so your team can use and manage the solution confidently. If you need ongoing maintenance, improvements, automation, analytics, or technical support, we can continue through an ongoing support arrangement.

q: How do you scope and price a project?
a: We start with a conversation to understand what you need, how the work is done today, and what the project needs to achieve. We then turn that into a written scope with clear deliverables, timelines, assumptions, and pricing, with larger projects broken into defined phases. If something changes along the way, we discuss the impact on scope, timeline, and cost before doing the additional work, so there are no unexpected charges.

q: Do you use AI to write our code, and will you tell us?
a: Yes, we use AI tools where they can improve speed, research, testing, documentation, and development efficiency. AI-generated work is reviewed, tested, and validated by our engineers before it becomes part of your solution, and we remain responsible for the quality, security, and functionality of what we deliver. If AI is used in a material part of your project, we will be transparent about how it is being used and what human review is applied.

q: Can you work with our existing systems, or do we need to start from scratch?
a: We can work with what you already have. Whether you need to improve an existing application, connect different systems, automate a manual process, add AI capabilities, or build something completely new, we first assess your current setup and recommend the most practical approach. We do not rebuild something from scratch simply because it is easier for us.

q: What if our needs change during the project?
a: We plan in phases and communicate regularly, so changes can be discussed and incorporated as we go. If something new is needed, we will clarify the impact on scope, timeline, and cost before proceeding.
